transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?
Student health sent me. They said my weight is too low to clear me for the youth workshops, and it’s kept dropping. But honestly, it just feels like what happens when I’m focused and busy.
Have you been intentionally trying to lose weight?

Yeah. I mean, I plan my day around not eating much—coffee before studio, maybe a few bites from the café if people are around. I avoid bread and oily food because it feels like it would undo the control I’ve worked for.
Do you have an intense fear of gaining weight or becoming fat?
Yes. Even thinking about gaining a pound makes me panic. If I eat a normal dinner, or something with butter in it, I feel like everyone will be able to see that I’ve lost control or discipline.
Have your menstrual periods become irregular or stopped completely?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of them closely.
Even though student health told you your weight is too low, do you still feel or see yourself as overweight?
I guess… when I look at photos from the showcase, I don’t see the artwork first. I zoom in on my arms and waist. If I look small enough, I feel more serious and put-together.
Could you tell me what your current height and weight are?

I don’t know the exact number off the top of my head. Student health said it’s too low to clear me for the youth workshops, and it’s been dropping. But I mean, I’ve just been busy and focused—it doesn’t feel like a big deal to me.
Do you remember roughly how many months it has been since your last menstrual period?
I honestly don’t know. I haven’t been marking it down, so I couldn’t say how many months.
Have you had any menstrual bleeding at all over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to it the past few months.
Are you currently taking birth control pills or using any other form of hormonal contraception?
I’m not sure what all counts as hormonal contraception. I don’t really know.
Do you take birth control pills, or have an IUD, patch, injection, or vaginal ring?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know if I’m using any of those things.
About how much weight have you lost since you started trying to lose weight?
I don’t know the exact amount. The number has kept dropping, but I guess it just happens when I’m really focused and busy. Student health said it was too low for the youth workshops.
Do you exercise excessively or feel driven to work out to burn off calories?
I’m not really sure what would count as excessive. I do work out sometimes, but I don’t know if I’m doing it to burn off calories exactly.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating?
I’m not sure what you mean by make myself. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Do you take laxatives to help control or lose weight?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know what would count as taking them for weight control.
Do you take any diet pills or appetite suppressants to help you lose weight?
I don’t know… what kinds of pills do you mean? I haven’t really thought of anything I take as an appetite suppressant.
Do you take any water pills or diuretics to help you lose weight?
I’m not really sure what counts as a water pill. I don’t think I take anything like that, but I’d need to know what you mean.
Did student health tell you what your BMI was, or whether your weight is considered severely underweight?

Student health said my weight was too low to clear me for the youth workshops. They said the number has kept dropping. I mean, I know they’re concerned, but it just feels like what happens when I’m focused and busy.
Do you have a specific target weight or an upper weight limit that you feel you must stay below?

I don’t have an exact number, but I feel like I can’t let it go up. Even gaining one pound makes me panic. If I eat a normal dinner, or something with butter, I start thinking everyone will be able to tell I’ve lost discipline.
Do you remember roughly how long ago you last had to use a pad or tampon?
I’m not sure exactly. I haven’t really been keeping track of that.
